card.name: Words in income-tax discussions
card.fires_on: Words in news-style passages about taxes on the wealthy, such as the Buffett rule, tax code, tax rates and taxpayers. It fires on tax words themselves and on nearby words that lead into them.

modes.label: Tax words themselves
modes.description: Tax-related nouns like taxpayers, taxes, tax cuts and returns.
modes.example: reduced<< taxes>> paid by the rich, and stripped away

modes.label: Words leading into tax terms
modes.description: Words or word parts just before or inside a tax phrase, such as loopholes or structuring income.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward tax words in English, Chinese and Vietnamese, such as tax, tax bureau and income tax.
card.plain: It lights up in articles about taxing the rich and predicts that a tax word comes next.
